description.text:
This position will be responsible for delighting clients around Asia through delivering retail measurement insights and analysis.
Main responsibilities include:
- Providing performance overview analysis and business issue analysis to Consumer-Packaged Goods clients around Taiwan and Asia.
- Providing in-depth consulting services and delivering insights and analytics as well as thought leadership.
- Understand NielsenIQ software and be able to leverage our data sets to teach clients and junior analyst as well as to conduct best in class analytics.
- Identify opportunities and work with the sales team to facilitate a commercial approach to help NielsenIQ grow
- To coach and manage insights associates within the assigned industry within their regional cluster.
- To own the planned/ad hoc category review presentations, by collaborating with Consulting (e.g. attending briefing session and check-in review sessions) and identifying workforce allocation within Insight Associates.
- To own Thought Leadership output for the assigned industry within their cluster and partner with the Cluster Leader to drive Thought Leadership for their industry across all Asia.
- Working closely with the Consulting Lead and Customer Support to transform customer experience.
Qualifications
- At least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in business
- 6+ years’ work experience, preferably within analytics and insights or market research
- Knowledge of the Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry
- Knowledge of research techniques and methodologies would be an advantage.
- Excellent analytical skills
- Excellent communication skills and presentation skills
- Experience managing people and developing talent.
- An ability to work independently and in a team.
- Good interpersonal skills are a must.
- Fluent in spoken and written English.
- Experience in Retail Measurement and Consumer Panel is an advantage.
